title: Infinite Horizons
description: Overhauls world generation with vast new horizons, diverse biomes, plants, and terrain
body:
**Infinite Horizons 1.0.0** is a meticulously crafted, performance-first Minecraft modpack designed for players who want stunning visuals, expansive exploration, and buttery-smooth gameplay at high render distances.

Created by **blissful**.

### Experience the Infinite

This pack transforms vanilla Minecraft into a breathtaking open-world adventure. With **Terralith** + **Tectonic** as the foundation, the Overworld feels truly alive — featuring dramatic mountain ranges, lush river valleys, intricate cave systems, and diverse, hand-crafted biomes that reward exploration. Enhanced by **Voxy World Gen V2** and **Additional Structures**, the world feels vast, natural, and full of discovery.

Paired with the custom **Bliss** shader (a refined Chocapic13 edit), the visuals are absolutely gorgeous — dynamic lighting, realistic water, atmospheric effects, and vibrant colors that make every sunrise, forest, and mountain peak memorable.

### Performance That Lets You Go Big

Infinite Horizons is heavily optimized to let you push your render distance far beyond vanilla limits while maintaining excellent performance:

- **Sodium + Iris** at the core with extensive tuning via Sodium Extra and Reese's Sodium Options.
- Advanced chunk loading and generation optimizations (**C2ME**, **Noisium**, **Lithium**, **ModernFix**, **Ksyxis**).
- Distant chunk rendering with **Bobby**.
- Intelligent culling (**Entity Culling**, **More Culling**), particle optimization (**Particle Core**), and rendering improvements (**ImmediatelyFast**, **BadOptimizations**).
- Memory and lag reduction through **FerriteCore**, **ThreadTweak**, and more.

The result? You can comfortably run 32+ chunk render distances with shaders on, while keeping high FPS and minimal stuttering — even during exploration or world generation.

### Quality-of-Life & Immersion Features

- **Bridging Mod** — intuitive reach-around and slab bridging.
- **Zoomify** — smooth, customizable zooming.
- **Do a Barrel Roll** — enhanced elytra flight with banking and momentum.
- **Not Enough Animations** + **Wavey Capes** — fluid, natural player and item animations.
- **AppleSkin** — detailed hunger and saturation HUD.
- Custom high-resolution resource packs including **Default HD 512x** and stylish crosshairs.
- Pre-configured **Chunky** settings for world pre-generation.

### Technical Highlights

- Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)
- Carefully balanced config tweaks across all major performance and visual mods
- Optimized for both exploration and long-term play
- Clean, focused mod list prioritizing stability and beauty

Whether you're a explorer who loves wandering endless, beautiful terrain, a builder who wants smooth performance while working on large projects, or someone who simply wants Minecraft to look and feel as good as possible in 2026 — **Infinite Horizons** delivers.

**Let the horizons be infinite.**

— blissful
